prompt: Create an original 60 second instrumental dub instrumental composition for quiet reading and reflective study. Mood: calm, intimate, warm. Instruments: round electric bass, organ, rimshot, echo guitar. Style: spacious offbeat chords with restrained tape delay. Tempo approximately 68 BPM; D major. Main idea: alternating short and long phrases. Keep the arrangement sparse and dynamics even; leave space for thought. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no humming, no singing, no speech, no lyrics, no vocal samples. Do not imitate any existing artist or melody. [00:00-00:20] Establish the main idea immediately with the core ensemble. [00:20-00:40] Develop the motif with a complementary instrumental counterline, preserving the intended energy. [00:40-01:00] Return to the main idea and give a musically resolved ending with a short natural tail. Finish around 01:00.

description.en: A smooth and groovy instrumental track featuring a prominent bassline, clean electric guitar melodies, and a steady drum beat, creating a relaxed and chill atmosphere.
description.zh: 一首流畅而富有律动的纯音乐，以突出的贝斯线、干净的电吉他旋律和稳定的鼓点为特色，营造出轻松愉悦的氛围。

metadataBasis: style/scenario/tempo/key/moods are prompt intent; duration is measured; energy and audioReview are model inference when energyBasis is automated-audio-review
